info.title: Prometheus Metrics Fetcher
info.description: Fetches Kubernetes pod and deployment metrics from the cluster's Prometheus

get.summary: Fetch pod and deployment metrics from Prometheus
get.description: Queries Prometheus for per-pod metrics in an EKS namespace over a time window and returns current, average and max values per pod (top 10 series). Use when checking CPU usage, memory usage, pod restarts / crash loops, or unavailable replicas.

parameters.name: metric_name
parameters.description: One of: pod_cpu_utilization (CPU cores used per pod), pod_memory_utilization (working-set bytes per pod), pod_restarts (container restarts in the last hour), deployment_replicas_unavailable, deployment_replicas_available. Any other value is run as a raw PromQL query, where {namespace} is substituted.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Kubernetes namespace. Defaults to boutique (the microservices: frontend, gateway, auth, orders, order-service, product-service, user-service, boutique-postgres).

parameters.name: hours_back
parameters.description: How many hours of data to retrieve (sampled every 5 minutes).
